description: Score social-post sentiment for a cashtag using a deterministic lexicon. Returns score (-1..1), positive/negative/neutral percentages, and example posts. Use this to score posts you have already collected; it fetches nothing itself, so pass the posts in.

posts.description: Array of post objects. Each must have a text field; id, ts, and author are optional.

name: social_cashtag_sentiment
title: Cashtag Sentiment
